deepspeed_resolved_config._comment: DeepSpeed ZeRO stage 2, no offload, no custom CUDA ops. The host nvcc is 10.1 against a 12.2 driver, so any JIT build would fail; DS_BUILD_OPS=0 and a plain torch.optim.AdamW keep this path pure Python + NCCL. CPU/NVMe offload is deliberately absent for the same reason (cpu_adam would need compiling).

config.recipe_comparison_note: DeepSpeed clipping/precision defaults may differ; not an isolated framework effect
